messages:
nina (AE): Quick sync 1: customer (payments platform) wants strict key custody. They asked: can Redwood accept keys that never leave their HSM (nCipher/Thales) and still use hosted inference? Need timeline for a POC, price delta, and what evidence we can give for auditors.

raj (sales-eng): Short: possible but with constraints. Two patterns: (A) bring-your-own-HSM where keys stay in their appliance and we call via a mutual-TLS gateway (we proxy requests but key ops happen in their HSM), or (B) import-wrapped-keys into their cloud KMS (CloudHSM-backed) and Redwood integrates like normal. Pattern A keeps key material fully on-prem. Pattern B is simpler operationally.

elaine (solutions): POC approach I'd recommend: 3 weeks. Week 0: kickoff + NDA + network diagram. Week 1: establish connectivity (VPN/VPC peering), exchange certs, validate mutual-TLS. Week 2: run encrypt/decrypt cycles, measure latency under a small load. Week 3: rotation drill + audit export and smoke tests. We will need their infra lead and HSM admin available for cert exchange.

raj (sales-eng): Quick config sample we give customers for gateway mode: 
```
gateway_mode: "mutual-tls"
hsm_endpoint: "https://hsm-gw.customer.example"
client_cert: "base64-der"
key_policy: "encrypt_only" # most payments customers want no decrypt on our side
```
Note: if they require encrypt-only semantics we do envelope encryption so Redwood never sees plaintext, only ciphertext + metadata.

thom (security): re: auditors 1: we can provide: (1) signed audit logs showing key_id, operation, and timestamp; (2) architecture diagram showing no plaintext egress; (3) our SOC2/ISO artifacts and FIPS compatibility statement. We do not hold unwrapped key material in BYOK gateway mode. For rotation: we support rewrap/rollover with dual-ring strategy so no downtime. Documentable rotation window is usually <2 minutes for TTL-invalidate caches but depends on client cache TTL.

nina (AE): They also want pricing: will hosted cover this or do they need Private/Dedicated?

raj (sales-eng): Pricing notes (very rough): one-time BYOK onboarding: $12k
$30k depending on complexity. Recurring connectivity/security add-on: $1.5k/mo. HSM bridging (if we broker ops to their appliance) extra $600/mo for secure bridge ops. If they need dedicated hardware isolation we often recommend Private deployment; that includes platform license and infra costs. For guaranteed HSM throughput SLAs add-on we price based on RPS; baseline: $200/mo per 1k crypto ops reserved. I can run a model if you share expected ops/day and latency SLO.

elaine (solutions): Operational caveat: if they choose on-prem HSM + hosted inference we'll need public egress from Redwood to their gateway or a peered VPC. They must accept that connectivity path or we do Private to keep everything internal. Also firewall allowlist + cert rotation windows matter.

thom (security): Questionnaire answers: "Do you manage customer's key material?" -> "No, in gateway BYOK mode key material remains in customer HSM; Redwood stores only ciphertext and key references. We can provide a documented key handling appendix." Also note: for FIPS validation we can attest compatibility but do not perform FIPS certification on customer HSMs.

contract-bot: Created ticket POC-4990: BYOK/HSM gateway POC for payments customer. Owner: elaine (solutions).

nina (AE): Great. Action items: raj to build pricing worksheet; elaine to send POC checklist + propose kickoff times; tom to attach BYOK appendix and list of artifacts auditors typically request. Can we try Thu 9am PT for kickoff?

raj (sales-eng): I'll do pricing. Please give me expected tx/sec and target p50/p99 latency.

elaine (solutions): Thu 9am PT works for me. I'll invite them and include an engineering slot for cert exchange.

thom (security): I'll attach the BYOK appendix to the ticket and highlight outstanding attestations (SOC2/ISO/FIPS statements).

nina (AE): Thanks team. I'll update customer and paste their numbers into raj's sheet. :rocket:
